title: Robert Yard to the Earl of Manchester, Whitehall, 12 and 16 Oct 1699 (Beinecke OSB MSS fc37 box 2 folders 49, 51)

steps.what: Found the Manchester papers' 'Diplomatic cipher, contemporary copy' (box 18/47) at Yale and transcribed its 1,456 slots.
Key checked against the contemporary interlinear decipherment of the 5 Oct 1699 sibling.
Transcribed the cipher groups of both target letters from the IIIF images.
Decoded all groups of both letters; three value differences in Yard's copy found from context.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): both letters linked to their group transcriptions and raw decodes (oct1x_ct.txt, oct1x_decoded.txt); the edited plaintext of both copied verbatim from NOTES.md to texts/plaintext.md; key_file key_raw.txt

outcome.method_basis: The Earl of Manchester's own 'Diplomatic cipher, contemporary copy', in his papers at Yale (OSB MSS fc37 box 18/47), was transcribed, checked against the interlinear decipherment of the 5 Oct 1699 sibling, and applied to both letters. Tomokiyo had already tied them to the THE=454 template and decoded their first groups.
outcome.notes: Five slips of Yard's pen noted; names agree with Beinecke summaries of neighbouring letters.

texts.label: Yard to Manchester, Whitehall, 12 Oct 1699 (Yale OID 16601173)
texts.summary: Robert Yard, under-secretary, to the Earl of Manchester, ambassador in Paris: messengers wait at Dover for Mills; the Lords Justices of Ireland report disaffected persons returning and an ill design against the government, with like intimations from Scotland, all said to be carried on very privately at Saint-Germain; a letter from Lebrun at Paris enclosing one for a Mr Gray was opened at the post house.

texts.label: Yard to Manchester, Whitehall, 16 Oct 1699 (Yale OID 16601175)
texts.summary: Mills has gone by way of Rouen, so warrants are out and three messengers watch the coast, London and Dover for him and Lord Drummond's priest; directions on Fowles; no goldsmith Cockburne in Round Court; Clance the periwig maker has gone to France and should be watched.

prior.where: Tomokiyo (cryptiana glorious.htm) identified THE=454 and decoded the first groups of each letter
